text:
Anya (Partnerships): Kicking off a focused thread to lock the partner GTM windows for the marketplace launch. Need confirmed press embargo lift time, blog publish cadence, microsite cutover window (blue/green if possible), and partner quote owners. APAC/EU constraints?
Mike (Marketing): Thinking global embargo lift on 2026-04-20 16:00 PT (that's 23:00 UTC). Keeps US afternoon coverage and gives APAC next-morning visibility. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (Platform): Microsite cutover needs a 2hr maintenance window. Recommend 02:00-04:00 UTC on launch day for minimal traffic. We can do blue/green with a 10-min DNS TTL switch.
Tom (Eng): Engineering can support blue/green. Request: 3h pre-cutover freeze on publishing pipelines, 1h pre-cutover promo freeze. We'll run smoke tests for 20m post-cutover.
Julia (Legal): Embargo wording approved. Need a final list of partners to include in the release and a confirmation that partner quotes are cleared for publication.
Anya (Partnerships): Partner list for press: CloudCloud, EdgeWorks, SI-Plus. @Mike can you confirm owner and signoff for each quote? Also flag any partner legal constraints (APAC translations, embargo exceptions).
Mike (Marketing): I'll ping partner PR owners now. Suggest partner blog stagger: partner blogs go live T+1 (day after) to avoid headline collision. Internal comms at T+2.
LaunchBot: Deployment note: microsite promotion to prod scheduled at epoch 1717286400 (operator scheduled).
Priya (Platform): Runbook snippet for cutover (will post full runbook to #eng-runtime):
```
# blue-green promote
kubectl apply -f marketplace-green-deploy.yaml
waitForHealth marketplace-green
switchTraffic marketplace -> green
monitor 00:10
rollbackIfError
```
Ensure DB migrations are backward-compatible; use feature flags for partner-specific tiles.
Tom (Eng): We'll implement a fallback that routes to legacy marketplace for 10 minutes if health checks fail. Also enabling extended logs for first hour.
Mike (Marketing): Draft timeline (high level):
- T-72h: final assets to partners (logos, quotes, embargo PDF)
- T-24h: embargo reminder + pre-release checklist to partners
- T-2h: code freeze & final smoke test start
- T: microsite cutover (02:00-04:00 UTC window)
- T+1: partner blogs & partner social posts (staggered windows by region)
- T+2: internal comms + customer success briefing
Anya (Partnerships): Action items: Mike - confirm partner quote owners and get signed quotes by EOD Wed; Priya - publish full runbook and rollback steps; Tom - standby and prep extended logs; Julia - confirm partner list and embargo wording posted to partners.
Priya (Platform): Will drop the runbook link in #eng-runtime in 30m. Also adding checklist for CDN invalidation and cert checks.
Tom (Eng): Quick call? 20m sync at 10:30 PT to reconcile runbook steps. @Mike @Anya pls confirm. :thumbsup:
Anya (Partnerships): Confirmed, 10:30 PT works for me. Adding meeting invite. Thanks everyone.
Julia (Legal): Noted. I'll send a short blurb for the partner legal approvals doc.
Mike (Marketing): On it — chasing partners now, will update thread with owners + expected publication times. :mag_right:
